raw:
I picked the ten that rest on more specific structural or saturation mechanisms and less on the generic "strong parent means smaller gain" story. They are mostly the skip-connect redundancy, floor-effect removal, parallel-path and edge-2 pooling cases. I left out the conv3x3 and none-edge pairs on the output edges, since those are the ones other models would most likely propose. I did not run any benchmark data, so these are judgments about which hypotheses are less likely to be proposed and could still hold.
